title: Locality and Symplectic Structure of Gradient Representations of Bogoliubov Dynamics: Reproducibility Code and Data
description: Source code, numerical verification data, convergence checks, independent scattering and Evans calculations, and generated figures accompanying a research manuscript on locality and symplectic structure in gradient representations of Bogoliubov dynamics. This record does not include the manuscript or editorial correspondence. The original test-7 N=8000 acceptance criterion is not met (absolute discrepancy approximately 1.15066e-7 against 1e-7 tolerance); refined-grid and independent-reference data are preserved.
